args.title: Handle Windows line endings in src/ingest/parser.ts
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Trim trailing carriage returns (\r) and empty lines before splitting or processing lines in parseStatement to correctly handle Windows line endings (\r\n).

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The parser splits lines by \n without stripping trailing carriage returns (\r) or handling multiple blank lines correctly when Windows line endings (\r\n) are present. We should trim trailing carriage returns and empty lines before processing lines in parseStatement.
